prompts.martial:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent animated combat VFX sprite atlas for the original tactical RPG Echoes of the Shattered Crown.
Create a production sprite sheet of magical effects ONLY, no characters, no weapons, no scenery, no ground, no words, no labels, no visible grid.
EXACT layout FOUR equal columns by EIGHT equal rows, square transparent image, preferably 1536x1536. Every cell contains one isolated effect frame centered at identical registration, comfortably inside the cell with at least 12% transparent margin. Four horizontal frames in each row. Each effect sequence occupies TWO consecutive rows: the first row is frames 1-4, the next row frames 5-8, read left to right. Total four sequences, eight frames each, 32 separate cells.
Animation progression within every eight-frame sequence: small gathering trace -> winding/growing -> fast expansion -> strongest readable contact -> curling breakup -> dispersing fragments -> faint last wisps -> tiny remnant. Each frame must be visibly different, but keep the exact center and effect identity stable. Last frame is not blank. Preserve isolated RGBA transparency between cells, no atmospheric background connecting cells.
Art style: delicate hand-painted pixel-influenced fantasy VFX, crisp sculpted silhouettes, restrained luminous cores, fine separated sparks, elegant curved motion arcs, soft color within the shapes but transparent outside. Designed to overlay small painted tactical characters on pale sage stone, so include readable colored edges and midtones, not only pale white glows. Original artwork. No photograph, no UI, no border, no drop shadow, no checkerboard painted into art.
Sequences, top to bottom:
Rows 1-2: SWORD STRIKE. A clean crescent of ivory light edged in worn brass, upper-left to lower-right diagonal slash, followed by separated warm sparks.
Rows 3-4: SUNDERING ARC. A wider sweeping olive-gold crescent, two curved cutting streaks flaring to a broad fan then breaking apart.
Rows 5-6: GLOAM PURSUIT. Sharp indigo and muted violet dagger-shaped streak of shadow energy diagonally crossing, with separated purple fragments. No actual dagger object.
Rows 7-8: LANTERN CONCORD. A warm brass and pale teal four-point starburst, gathered little lantern lights converging into a radiant coordinated burst and dispersing.
Keep all four sequences clearly separate, no content across cell boundaries.
